sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Settings template file
sections.what: Lists every setting the app reads, with placeholder values. This covers the OpenAI key, model choices, search chunk sizes, and log options.
sections.why: Likely reason: a shared template lets a person create a real settings file without putting secrets into shared code.
sections.watch_out: Never put the real key into this file, since it is meant to be shared and may be committed.

summary: A sample settings file that lists every setting the app reads, with placeholder values.
purpose: Serve as a safe template to copy into a real settings file.
why: Likely reason: keeping placeholders in a shared file keeps real secrets out of the shared code. The environment check also refers to this file as the template.
how: Copy the file to a new file named .env, replace the placeholder key with a real one, and adjust the other values as needed.
inputs: The user supplies the real API key and any changed values.
outputs: No output of its own. The values are read by app code that is not in the packet.
risks: A real key placed in this file could be shared or committed. The model name gpt-4 may be out of date, which is unclear from the code. Chunk sizes and retrieval count change search quality. The code that reads these settings is not visible here.
debug: If the key error appears, check that the placeholder was replaced in the real .env file. Check spelling of each setting name. Confirm the .env file is loaded by the app.
